citations.quote: By anchoring on earnings, the analyst develops the price-earnings ratio (P/E)
Abnormal earnings growth is the metric that captures the extra value, so the value of the equity for a going concern is Value of equity = Capitalized forward earnings
Analysts gather and process information to make investment decisions, including buy and sell recommendations

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Frames earnings-based valuation via the price-earnings ratio and abnormal earnings growth (AEG) — how an analyst values equity by capitalizing forward earnings and adding present value of expected abnormal earnings growth, in contrast with book-value-anchored residual-earnings models.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Earnings-Based Valuation
